title: Energy depends on the boundary
hook: Track stored units and the transfer crossing the chosen boundary.

doesNotKnow: Distinguish stored change from outward transfer across a stated boundary.

misconception: A fall in stored quantity means units disappeared without an accountable transfer.
objective: Distinguish stored change from outward transfer across a stated boundary.

claims.text: Energy accounting tracks transformations and transfers across a defined system boundary.
Richard P. Feynman, Six Easy Pieces (1994)
Balanced transfers retain {A}; extra outward transfer leaves {B}. The store’s decrease is accounted for by net transfer beyond its boundary.
Does it hold up? This conserves stated accounting units. It does not establish a physical law experimentally or represent every energy form.
claims.source: {"type":"source-access-hold","note":"No empirical effect or research verdict established. Only bounded arithmetic proposed."}

recall.question: A store starts at 20 and sends 3 to another store each step. After two steps, how much left it?
recall.why: Outward transfer totals 6; the remaining 14 answers a different question.
